skills.name: Subtract same-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities once they have a common denominator by subtracting numerators, keeping the denominator, and interpreting a zero numerator as 0.

skills.name: Find common denominator and convert
skills.definition: Find an appropriate common denominator for unlike fractions and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Manage mixed and whole-number parts
skills.definition: Separate, align, subtract, and recombine whole-number and fractional parts in expressions involving mixed numbers or whole numbers, including treating missing parts as zero.

skills.name: Borrow across whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units into fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Simplify fractional result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result to lowest terms after subtraction.
